#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int readIntFromInput() {

vector<string> readStringArray() {
    string line; getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);
    vector<string> tokens;
    string token;
    while (ss >> token) {
        tokens.push_back(token);
    }
    return tokens;
}

vector<int> readIntArray() {
    vector<string> tokens = readStringArray();
    vector<int> array(tokens.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < tokens.size(); i++) {
        array[i] = stoi(tokens[i]);
    }
    return array;
}

vector<char> fillXWithChar(const vector<char>& array, int size, char ch) {
    vector<char> result(size);
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        result[i] = (array[i] == 'X') ? ch : array[i];
    }
    return result;
}

long evaluatePattern(const vector<char>& str, int n) {
    if (n == 1 || str[0] == '0') return 0;
    long totalWays = 0;
    int underscoreCount = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i++) {
        if (str[i] == '_') underscoreCount++;
    }
    totalWays += checkForPattern(str, "25", n, underscoreCount);
    totalWays += checkForPattern(str, "50", n, underscoreCount);
    totalWays += checkForPattern(str, "75", n, underscoreCount);

    if (n > 2 && (str[0] == '_' || str[0] == '0')) {
        totalWays *= 9;
    }

    if (n >= 3) {
        if ((str[n - 1] == '_' || str[n - 1] == '0') && (str[n - 2] == '_' || str[n - 2] == '0')) {
            long tempVal = (long) pow(10, underscoreCount);
            if (str[0] == '_') tempVal *= 9;
            totalWays += tempVal;
        }
    }
    return totalWays;
}

long checkForPattern(const vector<char>& str, const string& suffix, int n, int un) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    char lastChar = suffix[1];
    char firstChar = suffix[0];
    if (str[n - 1] == '_' || str[n - 1] == lastChar) {
        if (str[n - 2] == '_' || str[n - 2] == firstChar) {
            return (long) pow(10, un);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int testCases = 1;
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    // Since original code has only one test case, we proceed directly
    // For multiple test cases, wrap in a loop
    vector<long> output;
    for (int t = 0; t < testCases; t++) {
        getline(cin, line);
        vector<char> lineChars(line.begin(), line.end());
        int length = lineChars.size();

        if (length == 1) {
            if (lineChars[0] == '0' || lineChars[0] == '_' || lineChars[0] == 'X' || lineChars[0] == '1') {
                cout << 1 << "\n";
                continue;
            }
        }

        long totalCount = 0;
        bool containsX = false;
        for (char c : lineChars) {
            if (c == 'X') {
                containsX = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (containsX) {
            for (char digit = '0'; digit <= '9'; digit++) {
                vector<char> filled = fillXWithChar(lineChars, length, digit);
                totalCount += evaluatePattern(filled, length);
            }
        } else {
            totalCount += evaluatePattern(lineChars, length);
        }
        cout << totalCount << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
